# Vendored front-end libraries

These files are frozen copies so the GitHub Pages demo does not load JavaScript from a third-party CDN at runtime (TF-02).

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `xterm.css`, `xterm.min.js` | `@xterm/xterm@5.5.0` | MIT (`LICENSE-xterm.txt`) |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit@0.10.0` | MIT (same project) |

Source maps were omitted so the demo does not request missing `.map` files.
